description: Minimum offline retrieval quality (npm run test:retrieval). Measured with the deterministic eval-lexicon-v1 embedder on eval/datasets/retrieval.jsonl (dataset version 2: 44 answerable + 17 unanswerable questions): Recall@1/3/5 = 0.82/0.95/1.00, MRR 0.92; confidence gate recall 0.98, specificity 0.71 (calibration 0.96 / 0.73, validation 1.00 / 0.67). The minimums sit below the measured values (and the tolerance below that) so that one flipped question does not fail the check, but a broken FTS query, vector scan, RRF, exact-token bonus, de-duplication, chunking or confidence gate does: the per-tag entries guard each path on its own (exact-term needs keyword search and the exact-token bonus, semantic-only needs vector search, missing-identifier needs the identifier rule of the gate). Raise them in a PR when quality has genuinely improved.
